title: SHAHEED-E-TEER-E-SITAM BEZABA'N ALI ASGHAR
body:
Chale hain khaime se phir laut kar na aaenge
Sawaale aab pa teere sitam ye khaaenge
Na baade dafn bhi marqad me chain paaenge
Hussain dil ko bhala kis tarahManaenge
<<MINI>>
Shaheede teere sitam Bezaba'n Ali Asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
Chala jo teer to kaampi zameene Karbobala
Chhidi jo gardane besheer to falak larza
Fazaa-e dasht me ek hashr hogaya barpa
Magar Hussain ka Beta tha Muskura Utha
<<MINI>>
Shaheede teere sitam Bezaba'n Ali Asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
Jo dekha Banu-e muztar ne dil larazne laga
Kaha ye ro ro ke HaayHaay ye kya hua Beta
Zara si der me veeran kar gaye jhoola
Rahega honton pa ta umr bas yehi Noha
<<MINI>>
Shaheede teere sitam Bezaba'n Ali Asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
Lahu bhare huwe honton ko choom kar ye kaha
Ye kisne teere sitam se tujhe shaheed kiya
Nazar na aaya usse kya ye phool sa chehra
Ye bain sun ke haram kar rahe the aaho buka
<<MINI>>
Shaheede teere sitam Bezaba'n Ali Asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
Bana ke nanhi si turbat zameene magqtal par
Ek aah sard bhari aur uth gaye Sarwar
Kahan hain Qasim o Abbas aur Ali Akbar
Falak ko dekh keek baar ye kaha rokar
<<MINI>>
Shaheede teere sitam Bezaba'n Ali Asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
Chale jo turbate besheer se suwe khaima
Hussain bekaso Mazloom tashna lab tanha
Fareed koi na tha dashte nainawa ke siwa
Faza me goonj rahi thi ye Fatima ki sada
<<MINI>>
Shaheede teere sitam Bezaba'n Ali Asghar
author: Mirza Fareed Baig
